subject.title: fix(ui): make the Control UI e2e suite green and gate merges on it

question: Should OpenClaw accept the full serial Control UI E2E suite as a required 45-minute merge-gate job after its exact-head run completes?
rationale: The implementation is a focused way to prevent accumulated browser regressions, but accepting the additional required CI runtime and queue cost is an operational maintainer decision rather than a code-correctness inference.

options.title: Rebase and require the full suite
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, remove the already-merged overlap, and accept the expanded required job if `checks-ui-e2e` and `ci-gate` complete successfully.

options.title: Keep a narrower gate
options.body: Retain the existing targeted E2E job and track broader suite stabilization separately if the required-job runtime is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Rebase and require the full suite
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, remove the already-merged overlap, and accept the expanded required job if `checks-ui-e2e` and `ci-gate` complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this contributor to the recent Control UI behavior and CI-test work that the gate consolidates.
